concept: A LEGO model of a chunky cylindrical lighthouse tower with a red-and-white striped body, a lantern room on top, and a small rocky base plate. (changed: Made the tower a straight stacked-brick cylinder instead of a tapering realistic shape, since tapering needs many angled parts; Replaced a rotating light beam with a single bright round tile/dome, since light beams can't be physically built)
